workspace.rules.help: Rules decide which commands run without asking, which are asked, and which are refused. An Allow rule covers one plain command, never a command line with pipes or lists. Forbidden rules are advisory: they catch the commands Elitea can see, not what a script starts; the sandbox is what bounds a command. Your organisation’s policy always comes first.
